judge_panel.reasoning: The reviewer does not flag the GRPO description or challenge the claim about policy-gradient fine-tuning against the cited source. No mention of the 'group-relative' qualifier or the GRPO citation being mischaracterized.

The review discusses regression control and methodological confounds, but it does not challenge the specific Sec. 2.1 claim about 'policy-gradient fine-tuning of model weights' against the cited GRPO source or label that citation claim as unsupported/mischaracterized.
The reviewer summary and analysis focus on the primary methods (GEPA, Meta Harness, RELAI-VCL) and do not mention the GRPO method or challenge its description in Section 2.1.
